name: PaidSync.ai
description:
PaidSync is an MCP server that lets your AI assistant operate your own paid media accounts across 13 platforms from one endpoint. Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Snapchat Ads, Reddit Ads, Pinterest Ads, Microsoft Ads, and ChatGPT Ads, plus Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Search Console, and Merchant Center.

Ask Claude to audit an account, compare performance across platforms, find wasted spend, draft budget and bid changes, build audiences, write ads, or set up conversion tracking through GTM and GA4. PaidSync changes campaign settings only. It never moves money or processes payments, and billing stays directly between you and each ad platform. Every write is drafted for your review and nothing applies until you confirm.

It is the only MCP with write access to LinkedIn, TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Pinterest, and Microsoft Ads. Built by a Google Premier Partner with more than $500M in managed ad spend. Free to start with 15 tool calls a month.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PaidSync.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PaidSync.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.paidsync.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PaidSync.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PaidSync.ai lists 39 MCP tools, including clear_active_account, connect_facebook_ads, connect_ga4, connect_google_ads, connect_google_search_console, connect_gtm, connect_linkedin_ads, connect_merchant_center, connect_microsoft_ads, connect_openai_ads, connect_pinterest_ads, and connect_reddit_ads.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PaidSync.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to PaidSync.ai in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
PaidSync.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PaidSync.ai is developed by PaidSync.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
